nodes.label: Refresh token rotation with 60 s idempotent retry
nodes.rationale: Reuse of a used refresh token signals theft and revokes the device; a 60 s grace window returns the same new token so a lost network response does not log the user out.

nodes.label: device_revoked error with reason
nodes.rationale: Only device_revoked wipes local data; plain 401 only refreshes/relogs, so old clients degrade safely without wiping.

nodes.label: REST error format { error: { code, message } }
Client-generated UUIDv7 ids with idempotent POST
nodes.rationale: Repeat POST with same id and body is 200, with different body 409 conflict — makes retries safe offline.

nodes.label: POST /auth/prelogin deterministic fake salt
nodes.rationale: Unknown emails get a deterministic fake salt so accounts cannot be enumerated.

nodes.label: Signup gating and limits (DS_SIGNUP, DS_SIGNUP_DAILY_LIMIT, NEW_USER_STORAGE_QUOTA_BYTES, ds quota)
nodes.rationale: Security review 2026-11-02: daily signup cap and a small default quota for new accounts limit abuse of an open server; any conflict returns one identical 409.

nodes.label: PATCH /docs/:id (move note to another notebook)
nodes.rationale: Server changes only the notebook; content, history, attachments and noteKey stay; client rewraps noteKey first so no separate key transfer is needed.

nodes.label: Author type (user / guest / agent)
nodes.rationale: Author is set by the server from who sent the update, not by the client (D-54).

nodes.label: Opaque guest author id sha256("ds-guest-author|"+shareId)
nodes.rationale: The share id itself grants a guest token, so it must never be sent to clients; an opaque stable UUIDv7-shaped hash is used instead (security review 2026-11-02).

nodes.label: Account box key pair /me/box-key and /users/:userId/public-key
nodes.rationale: Public key lookup only for related accounts; otherwise 404 indistinguishable from nonexistent, preventing enumeration.

nodes.label: Invitations
nodes.rationale: POST /invitations responds identically and in equal time whether the account exists, so emails cannot be probed; 30-day lifetime; 50 per day per inviter.

nodes.label: Owner confirmation for accountCreatedAfterInvite
nodes.rationale: Email is not verified at signup, so an account created after the invitation gets the key only after the owner explicitly confirms (owner decision 2026-10-27).

nodes.label: keyRotationPending / pendingSinceVersion
nodes.rationale: Lets any owner device detect where an interrupted key rotation stopped and resume it.

nodes.label: Limit 50 people per resource (incl. pending invitations)
Everything shared belongs to the owner (quota, deletion)
Member agents access to shared for-agents notebooks
Shared spaces REST (/spaces, kind space in members/invitations)
Space type { id, ownerUserId, keyVersion, keyRotationPending, pendingSinceVersion }
GET/PUT /spaces/:id/notebooks (space-wrapped notebook keys)
nodes.rationale: Listing is given to any accepted member at any key version: wraps reveal nothing without the space key, and members would otherwise lose the list mid-rotation.

nodes.label: Space member rights (editor creates notebooks, writes space doc; owner-only delete/mode/move)
D-54 member operations on a space notebook return 409
nodes.rationale: A space notebook has no own members; its keys are rotated by /spaces/:id/rotate.

nodes.label: spaceKeyVersion on POST /notebooks with spaceId
nodes.rationale: Rejects with 409 a notebook wrapped under a stale space key during rotation, so it is not left under the old key.

nodes.label: SharedItem docIds order for a space

hyperedges.label: Shared resource key rotation flow (rotate → note keys → rotate/done)
